title: Inherited modified-file notice inventory

scope.description: Public-safe tracked paths with exact counterparts at the pinned sal063 revision. Private PGF/PGD, key, font, game-input, capture, and oracle paths are excluded. Generated outputs are recorded separately and are not hand-edited.
scope.history_date_policy: Use the latest available public-history commit touching each path before this campaign; the sanitized public export is the first public-history boundary.

notice_policy.pointer: See NOTICE.md for upstream lineage and modification provenance.
notice_policy.unchanged_files: Retain SPDX and immediate-upstream attribution; no modification sentence is asserted for paths bounded as unchanged.
notice_policy.generated_files: Do not insert text into generated arrays; retain provenance in the source/generator and this manifest.

legal_basis.gpl_v2_section: GNU GPLv2 section 2(a) requires modified files to carry prominent notices stating the change and date.
legal_basis.gpl_v3_section: GNU GPLv3 section 5(a) requires prominent notices that the work was modified and a relevant date.
legal_basis.fsf_guidance: FSF guidance recommends a copying-permission pointer at the beginning of each source file; this inventory is an engineering provenance gate, not legal advice or legal clearance.

required_license_files.role: verbatim GPLv2 license text for inherited GPL-2.0-or-later files
